FX.title: [USD/JPY] DOWN: AI Detects Weakness Below MA20 as BOJ Hawkishness Looms
tldr_points: BOJ hike expectations lift yen, pressuring USD/JPY downward.
Price sits below MA20 with RSI ~29, indicating oversold conditions.
Fed CPI and ECB policy add mixed USD pressure but yen strength dominates.

FX.comment: BOJ hike expectations and bearish technicals favor downside move toward 152.00.

STOCKS.title: [S&P 500] DOWN: Oil Spike & Yield Rise Pressure Valuations
tldr_points: S&P 500 trades below its 20‑day MA as oil prices and Treasury yields climb.
Hotter‑than‑expected CPI data fuels September Fed‑hike expectations, weighing on equities.
Technical stance remains bearish with RSI near 45 and resistance at MA20.
STOCKS.excerpt: S&P 500 falls below MA20 on oil jump, yield rise, hot CPI, boosting Sept rate‑hike odds and bias for investors -.
STOCKS.comment: Bearish bias from rising rates, oil surge, and technical weakness below MA20.
